errors.evidence: The description states the Precision score starts at 65.78%, but the value for the purple Precision line at 'Full model (Ours)' is 65.45%. The value 65.78% corresponds to the Recall line.

When describing the Precision line, the text states the value for 'w/o Augmentation' is 62.22%. However, the chart shows the value for Precision (purple line) at this point is 63.70%. The value 62.22% corresponds to the F1-score at that point.

The description states the Recall score begins at 65.46%. The chart shows the value for the blue Recall line at 'Full model (Ours)' is 65.78%. The value 65.46% is not present for any line at that point and appears to be a typo for either 65.45% (Precision) or 65.49% (F1-score).

When describing the Recall line, the text states the value for 'w/o Augmentation' is 63.75%. The chart shows the value for the blue Recall line at this point is 62.63%. The value 63.75% is not present in the chart.

When describing the F1-score line, the text states the value for 'w/o Augmentation' is 62.63%. However, the chart shows the value for the brown F1-score line at this point is 62.22%. The value 62.63% corresponds to the Recall line at that point.
